description: This file defines a React component named 'Gallery' that renders a responsive, lazy-loading image gallery with a lightbox overlay for image preview. It manages state for active images, handles keyboard navigation, and incorporates CSS-in-JS styling.

methods.name: local
methods.description: Helper function to require local image assets based on a number.

methods.name: openLightbox
methods.description: Handles opening the lightbox overlay and saving the trigger element for focus restoration.

methods.name: closeLightbox
methods.description: Closes the lightbox overlay and restores focus to the trigger element for accessibility.
